finalists.label: WDR19-related disorder
finalists.why: Compound heterozygous variants in WDR19 gene and specific clinical findings such as temporary calcified zone at distal end of metacarpals and short and broad metacarpals and phalanges.

finalists.label: Nephropathy
finalists.why: Prenatal ultrasound showed slightly enhanced parenchymal echoes and enlarged kidneys bilaterally, elevated serum creatinine, and increased renal echogenicity.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of compound heterozygous variants in the WDR19 gene along with specific clinical findings like abnormal electrical activity in the brain and skeletal abnormalities decided the final comparison.
